'''July 2001 Anderson tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Planet Comics, Anderson, South Carolina on 21 July 2001. [[Caleb Foth]] won it. It is known from Brad Reinhold's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2745">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-30-anderson-1-week-before-dpc-atlantad2745/ anderson-1-week-before-dpc-atlanta], DeckTech (Brad "Admiral Twk" Reinhold, 30 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-30-anderson-1-week-before-dpc-atlantad2745/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Planet Comics, Anderson, South Carolina
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Caleb Foth]]
